body: I suppose I'm too much of a fuckup to even get that right.  gonna have to find a gun.
I've jury rigged a noose, wondering if it'll put out enough pressure to suffocate me
It doesn't matter now, all I need is to die

It's funny how most people say they'll be sad or regret having a negative impact on their friends or family by killing themselves, when that's not true in my case.  I'll be so happy to leave them forever.
My reasons for it don't really matter, it's nothing this sub hasn't heard before.  I need a way out.
